stats: /* fp_d1ed7f9d75b5b6a2 */ WITH PIAGENT_WALL_QUERY (PIAGENT_COL_0,PIAGENT_COL_1,PIAGENT_COL_2,PIAGENT_COL_3,PIAGENT_COL_4,PIAGENT_COL_5,PIAGENT_COL_6,PIAGENT_COL_7,PIAGENT_COL_8) AS (SELECT FILE#, SET_STAMP, SET_COUNT, INCREMENTAL_LEVEL, CHECKPOINT_CHANGE#, CHECKPOINT_TIME, COMPLETION_TIME, RESETLOGS_CHANGE#, CREATION_CHANGE# FROM V$BACKUP_DATAFILE WHERE FILE# > 0 ORDER BY COMPLETION_TIME DESC) SELECT PIAGENT_COL_0 AS "FILE#",PIAGENT_COL_1 AS "SET_STAMP",PIAGENT_COL_2 AS "SET_COUNT",PIAGENT_COL_3 AS "INCREMENTAL_LEVEL",PIAGENT_COL_4 AS "CHECKPOINT_CHANGE#",TO_CHAR(PIAGENT_COL_5, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS "CHECKPOINT_TIME",TO_CHAR(PIAGENT_COL_6, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS "COMPLETION_TI
/* fp_d1ed7f9d75b5b6a2 */ SELECT FILE#, ONLINE_STATUS, ERROR, CHANGE#, TIME FROM V$RECOVER_FILE ORDER BY FILE#
/* fp_d1ed7f9d75b5b6a2 */ SELECT OWNER, OBJECT_TYPE, COUNT(*) STALE_COUNT FROM DBA_TAB_STATISTICS WHERE STALE_STATS = 'YES' GROUP BY OWNER, OBJECT_TYPE ORDER BY OWNER, OBJECT_TYPE
/* fp_d1ed7f9d75b5b6a2 */ SELECT tablespace_name,status,SUM(bytes) FROM dba_undo_extents GROUP BY tablespace_name,status ORDER BY tablespace_name,status
/* fp_d1ed7f9d75b5b6a2 */ SELECT FILE#, NAME, CREATION_CHANGE# FROM V$DATAFILE ORDER BY FILE#

/* fp_d1ed7f9d75b5b6a2 */ SELECT OBJECT_ID, OWNER, OBJECT_NAME FROM DBA_OBJECTS WHERE OBJECT_ID IN (SELECT OBJECT_ID FROM V$LOCKED_OBJECT UNION SELECT ROW_WAIT_OBJ# FROM V$SESSION WHERE ROW_WAIT_OBJ# > 0) ORDER BY OBJECT_ID
/* fp_d1ed7f9d75b5b6a2 */ SELECT OWNER, INDEX_NAME, TABLE_OWNER, TABLE_NAME, STATUS FROM DBA_INDEXES WHERE STATUS IN ('UNUSABLE', 'INVALID') ORDER BY OWNER, INDEX_NAME

/* fp_d1ed7f9d75b5b6a2 */ SELECT SYS_CONTEXT('USERENV','SESSION_USER'), SYS_CONTEXT('USERENV','ISDBA'), SYS_CONTEXT('USERENV','PROXY_USER'), SYS_CONTEXT('USERENV','CON_ID'), SYS_CONTEXT('USERENV','CON_NAME') FROM dual

/* fp_d1ed7f9d75b5b6a2 */ WITH PIAGENT_WALL_QUERY (PIAGENT_COL_0,PIAGENT_COL_1,PIAGENT_COL_2,PIAGENT_COL_3,PIAGENT_COL_4,PIAGENT_COL_5) AS (SELECT USERNAME, ORACLE_MAINTAINED, ACCOUNT_STATUS, PROFILE, EXPIRY_DATE, LAST_LOGIN FROM DBA_USERS ORDER BY USERNAME) SELECT PIAGENT_COL_0 AS "USERNAME",PIAGENT_COL_1 AS "ORACLE_MAINTAINED",PIAGENT_COL_2 AS "ACCOUNT_STATUS",PIAGENT_COL_3 AS "PROFILE",TO_CHAR(PIAGENT_COL_4, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS "EXPIRY_DATE",PIAGENT_COL_5 AS "LAST_LOGIN" FROM PIAGENT_WALL_QUERY
/* fp_d1ed7f9d75b5b6a2 */ SELECT NAME, STATUS, IS_RECOVERY_DEST_FILE FROM V$CONTROLFILE ORDER BY NAME
/* fp_d1ed7f9d75b5b6a2 */ SELECT TO_NUMBER(SYS_CONTEXT('USERENV','SID')) SID FROM DUAL

/* fp_d1ed7f9d75b5b6a2 */ SELECT t.tablespace_name,t.contents,t.bigfile,f.file_name,f.bytes,f.autoextensible,f.maxbytes,NVL(x.free_bytes,0),CASE WHEN t.contents='TEMPORARY' THEN (SELECT NVL(SUM(s.used_blocks),0)*t.block_size FROM v$sort_segment s WHERE s.tablespace_name=t.tablespace_name) WHEN t.contents='UNDO' THEN (SELECT NVL(SUM(u.bytes),0) FROM dba_undo_extents u WHERE u.tablespace_name=t.tablespace_name AND u.status IN ('ACTIVE','UNEXPIRED')) ELSE m.used_space*t.block_size END FROM dba_tablespaces t JOIN (SELECT tablespace_name,file_name,bytes,autoextensible,maxbytes FROM dba_data_files UNION ALL SELECT tablespace_name,file_name,bytes,autoextensible,maxbytes FROM dba_temp_files) f ON f.

/* fp_d1ed7f9d75b5b6a2 */ WITH PIAGENT_WALL_QUERY (PIAGENT_COL_0,PIAGENT_COL_1,PIAGENT_COL_2,PIAGENT_COL_3,PIAGENT_COL_4) AS (SELECT FILE#, ONLINE_STATUS, ERROR, CHANGE#, TIME FROM V$RECOVER_FILE ORDER BY FILE#) SELECT PIAGENT_COL_0 AS "FILE#",PIAGENT_COL_1 AS "ONLINE_STATUS",PIAGENT_COL_2 AS "ERROR",PIAGENT_COL_3 AS "CHANGE#",TO_CHAR(PIAGENT_COL_4, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS "TIME" FROM PIAGENT_WALL_QUERY
/* fp_d1ed7f9d75b5b6a2 */ SELECT SESSION_KEY, INPUT_TYPE, STATUS, START_TIME, END_TIME, OUTPUT_BYTES FROM V$RMAN_BACKUP_JOB_DETAILS ORDER BY START_TIME DESC
/* fp_d1ed7f9d75b5b6a2 */ SELECT value FROM v$parameter WHERE name='undo_retention'

/* fp_d1ed7f9d75b5b6a2 */ SELECT p.privilege, p.owner, u.oracle_maintained FROM (SELECT privilege, owner FROM user_tab_privs WHERE grantee = SYS_CONTEXT('USERENV','SESSION_USER') UNION ALL SELECT privilege, owner FROM role_tab_privs WHERE role IN (SELECT role FROM session_roles)) p LEFT JOIN all_users u ON u.username=p.owner

/* fp_d1ed7f9d75b5b6a2 */ SELECT WINDOW_NAME, ENABLED, ACTIVE, TO_CHAR(LAST_START_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3TZH:TZM') LAST_START_DATE, TO_CHAR(NEXT_START_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3TZH:TZM') NEXT_START_DATE, DURATION FROM DBA_SCHEDULER_WINDOWS ORDER BY WINDOW_NAME
/* fp_d1ed7f9d75b5b6a2 */ SELECT INDEX_OWNER, INDEX_NAME, PARTITION_NAME, STATUS FROM DBA_IND_PARTITIONS WHERE STATUS IN ('UNUSABLE', 'INVALID') ORDER BY INDEX_OWNER, INDEX_NAME, PARTITION_NAME

/* fp_d1ed7f9d75b5b6a2 */ SELECT s.sid,s.username,u.sql_id,u.segtype,u.tablespace,u.blocks*t.block_size FROM v$tempseg_usage u JOIN v$session s ON s.saddr=u.session_addr JOIN dba_tablespaces t ON t.tablespace_name=u.tablespace ORDER BY u.blocks DESC,s.sid

/* fp_d1ed7f9d75b5b6a2 */ SELECT f.tablespace_name,f.file_name,f.bytes,f.autoextensible,f.maxbytes FROM dba_data_files f JOIN dba_tablespaces t ON t.tablespace_name=f.tablespace_name WHERE t.contents='UNDO' ORDER BY f.file_id

/* fp_d1ed7f9d75b5b6a2 */ SELECT D.USERNAME, U.ACCOUNT_STATUS, U.ORACLE_MAINTAINED FROM DBA_USERS_WITH_DEFPWD D JOIN DBA_USERS U ON U.USERNAME = D.USERNAME WHERE U.ACCOUNT_STATUS LIKE 'OPEN%' ORDER BY D.USERNAME
/* fp_d1ed7f9d75b5b6a2 */ SELECT FILE#, BLOCK#, BLOCKS, CORRUPTION_CHANGE#, CORRUPTION_TYPE FROM V$DATABASE_BLOCK_CORRUPTION ORDER BY FILE#, BLOCK#

/* fp_d1ed7f9d75b5b6a2 */ WITH PIAGENT_WALL_QUERY (PIAGENT_COL_0,PIAGENT_COL_1,PIAGENT_COL_2,PIAGENT_COL_3,PIAGENT_COL_4,PIAGENT_COL_5) AS (SELECT THREAD#, SEQUENCE#, FIRST_CHANGE#, NEXT_CHANGE#, FIRST_TIME, RESETLOGS_CHANGE# FROM V$LOG_HISTORY ORDER BY RESETLOGS_CHANGE#, THREAD#, SEQUENCE#) SELECT PIAGENT_COL_0 AS "THREAD#",PIAGENT_COL_1 AS "SEQUENCE#",PIAGENT_COL_2 AS "FIRST_CHANGE#",PIAGENT_COL_3 AS "NEXT_CHANGE#",TO_CHAR(PIAGENT_COL_4, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS "FIRST_TIME",PIAGENT_COL_5 AS "RESETLOGS_CHANGE#" FROM PIAGENT_WALL_QUERY
/* fp_d1ed7f9d75b5b6a2 */ SELECT SID, BLOCKER_SID FROM V$WAIT_CHAINS WHERE BLOCKER_SID IS NOT NULL ORDER BY SID, BLOCKER_SID
/* fp_d1ed7f9d75b5b6a2 */ SELECT SET_STAMP, SET_COUNT, BACKUP_TYPE, INCREMENTAL_LEVEL, START_TIME, COMPLETION_TIME, PIECES FROM V$BACKUP_SET ORDER BY COMPLETION_TIME DESC

/* fp_d1ed7f9d75b5b6a2 */ SELECT OWNER, JOB_NAME, ENABLED, STATE, TO_CHAR(LAST_START_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3TZH:TZM') LAST_START_DATE, TO_CHAR(NEXT_RUN_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3TZH:TZM') NEXT_RUN_DATE, RUN_COUNT, FAILURE_COUNT FROM DBA_SCHEDULER_JOBS ORDER BY OWNER, JOB_NAME

/* fp_d1ed7f9d75b5b6a2 */ SELECT s.tablespace_name,SUM(s.total_blocks*t.block_size),SUM(s.used_blocks*t.block_size),SUM(s.free_blocks*t.block_size) FROM v$sort_segment s JOIN dba_tablespaces t ON t.tablespace_name=s.tablespace_name GROUP BY s.tablespace_name ORDER BY s.tablespace_name
/* fp_d1ed7f9d75b5b6a2 */ SELECT MAX(maxquerylen),SUM(ssolderrcnt),SUM(nospaceerrcnt),MIN(tuned_undoretention),MAX(tuned_undoretention) FROM v$undostat WHERE begin_time>=SYSDATE-1
/* fp_d1ed7f9d75b5b6a2 */ SELECT USERNAME, ORACLE_MAINTAINED, ACCOUNT_STATUS, PROFILE, EXPIRY_DATE, LAST_LOGIN FROM DBA_USERS ORDER BY USERNAME

/* fp_d1ed7f9d75b5b6a2 */ SELECT SID, SERIAL#, USERNAME, OSUSER, MACHINE, PROGRAM, TYPE, STATUS, SQL_ID, PREV_SQL_ID, EVENT, WAIT_CLASS, STATE, SECONDS_IN_WAIT, LAST_CALL_ET, TO_CHAR(SYS_EXTRACT_UTC(FROM_TZ(CAST(LOGON_TIME AS TIMESTAMP), TO_CHAR(SYSTIMESTAMP, 'TZR'))), 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"') LOGON_TIME, BLOCKING_SESSION, FINAL_BLOCKING_SESSION, ROW_WAIT_OBJ# FROM V$SESSION WHERE SID <> TO_NUMBER(SYS_CONTEXT('USERENV','SID')) AND (:background = 1 OR TYPE = 'USER') ORDER BY SID
/* fp_d1ed7f9d75b5b6a2 */ SELECT THREAD#, SEQUENCE#, FIRST_CHANGE#, NEXT_CHANGE#, FIRST_TIME, RESETLOGS_CHANGE# FROM V$LOG_HISTORY ORDER BY RESETLOGS_CHANGE#, THREAD#, SEQUENCE#

/* fp_d1ed7f9d75b5b6a2 */ SELECT ID, OPERATION, TARGET, TO_CHAR(START_TIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3TZH:TZM') START_TIME, TO_CHAR(END_TIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3TZH:TZM') END_TIME, STATUS FROM DBA_OPTSTAT_OPERATIONS WHERE START_TIME >= TO_TIMESTAMP_TZ(:fromTime, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3TZH:TZM') AND START_TIME < TO_TIMESTAMP_TZ(:toTime, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3TZH:TZM') ORDER BY DBA_OPTSTAT_OPERATIONS.START_TIME DESC, ID DESC

/* fp_d1ed7f9d75b5b6a2 */ SELECT INDEX_OWNER, INDEX_NAME, PARTITION_NAME, SUBPARTITION_NAME, STATUS FROM DBA_IND_SUBPARTITIONS WHERE STATUS IN ('UNUSABLE', 'INVALID') ORDER BY INDEX_OWNER, INDEX_NAME, PARTITION_NAME, SUBPARTITION_NAME
/* fp_d1ed7f9d75b5b6a2 */ SELECT SESSION_ID, OBJECT_ID, LOCKED_MODE FROM V$LOCKED_OBJECT ORDER BY SESSION_ID, OBJECT_ID
/* fp_d1ed7f9d75b5b6a2 */ SELECT file_type,percent_space_used,percent_space_reclaimable,number_of_files FROM v$flash_recovery_area_usage ORDER BY file_type
/* fp_d1ed7f9d75b5b6a2 */ SELECT CLIENT_NAME, STATUS, WINDOW_GROUP FROM DBA_AUTOTASK_CLIENT ORDER BY CLIENT_NAME
/* fp_d1ed7f9d75b5b6a2 */ SELECT tablespace_name,file_name,bytes,autoextensible,maxbytes FROM dba_temp_files ORDER BY file_id

/* fp_d1ed7f9d75b5b6a2 */ SELECT SYS_CONTEXT('USERENV','DB_NAME'), SYS_CONTEXT('USERENV','INSTANCE_NAME'), SYS_CONTEXT('USERENV','SERVER_HOST'), CASE WHEN SYS_CONTEXT('USERENV','CON_ID')='0' THEN 'NO' ELSE 'YES' END, SYS_CONTEXT('USERENV','SESSION_USER'), SYS_CONTEXT('USERENV','CURRENT_SCHEMA'), SYS_CONTEXT('USERENV','CON_NAME'), TO_CHAR(SYSTIMESTAMP, 'TZH:TZM') FROM dual

/* fp_d1ed7f9d75b5b6a2 */ SELECT OWNER, JOB_NAME, LOG_ID, TO_CHAR(LOG_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3TZH:TZM') LOG_DATE, STATUS, ERROR#, TO_CHAR(ACTUAL_START_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3TZH:TZM') ACTUAL_START_DATE, RUN_DURATION, ADDITIONAL_INFO FROM DBA_SCHEDULER_JOB_RUN_DETAILS WHERE LOG_DATE >= TO_TIMESTAMP_TZ(:fromTime, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3TZH:TZM') AND LOG_DATE < TO_TIMESTAMP_TZ(:toTime, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3TZH:TZM') ORDER BY DBA_SCHEDULER_JOB_RUN_DETAILS.LOG_DATE DESC, LOG_ID DESC

/* fp_d1ed7f9d75b5b6a2 */ WITH PIAGENT_WALL_QUERY (PIAGENT_COL_0,PIAGENT_COL_1,PIAGENT_COL_2,PIAGENT_COL_3,PIAGENT_COL_4,PIAGENT_COL_5) AS (SELECT SESSION_KEY, INPUT_TYPE, STATUS, START_TIME, END_TIME, OUTPUT_BYTES FROM V$RMAN_BACKUP_JOB_DETAILS ORDER BY START_TIME DESC) SELECT PIAGENT_COL_0 AS "SESSION_KEY",PIAGENT_COL_1 AS "INPUT_TYPE",PIAGENT_COL_2 AS "STATUS",TO_CHAR(PIAGENT_COL_3, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS "START_TIME",TO_CHAR(PIAGENT_COL_4, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS "END_TIME",PIAGENT_COL_5 AS "OUTPUT_BYTES" FROM PIAGENT_WALL_QUERY
/* fp_d1ed7f9d75b5b6a2 */ SELECT OWNER, COUNT(*) OBJECT_COUNT FROM DBA_OBJECTS GROUP BY OWNER ORDER BY OWNER

/* fp_d1ed7f9d75b5b6a2 */ SELECT THREAD#, SEQUENCE#, RESETLOGS_CHANGE#, FIRST_CHANGE#, NEXT_CHANGE#, FIRST_TIME, NEXT_TIME, STATUS, DELETED, NAME FROM V$ARCHIVED_LOG ORDER BY RESETLOGS_CHANGE#, THREAD#, SEQUENCE#

/* fp_d1ed7f9d75b5b6a2 */ SELECT FILE#, SET_STAMP, SET_COUNT, INCREMENTAL_LEVEL, CHECKPOINT_CHANGE#, CHECKPOINT_TIME, COMPLETION_TIME, RESETLOGS_CHANGE#, CREATION_CHANGE# FROM V$BACKUP_DATAFILE WHERE FILE# > 0 ORDER BY COMPLETION_TIME DESC

/* fp_d1ed7f9d75b5b6a2 */ SELECT ORIGINATING_TIMESTAMP, MESSAGE_LEVEL, PROBLEM_KEY, MESSAGE_TEXT, CON_ID FROM V$DIAG_ALERT_EXT WHERE ORIGINATING_TIMESTAMP >= TO_TIMESTAMP_TZ(:fromTime, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3TZH:TZM') AND ORIGINATING_TIMESTAMP < TO_TIMESTAMP_TZ(:toTime, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3TZH:TZM') AND INSTR(UPPER(MESSAGE_TEXT), UPPER(:text)) > 0 AND (SYS_CONTEXT('USERENV','CON_ID') IN ('0','1') OR CON_ID IN (0,1) OR CON_ID = TO_NUMBER(SYS_CONTEXT('USERENV','CON_ID'))) ORDER BY ORIGINATING_TIMESTAMP DESC, RECORD_ID DESC FETCH FIRST :fetchLimit ROWS ONLY
/* fp_d1ed7f9d75b5b6a2 */ SELECT version_full FROM product_component_version WHERE product LIKE 'Oracle%Database%'

/* fp_d1ed7f9d75b5b6a2 */ WITH PIAGENT_WALL_QUERY (PIAGENT_COL_0,PIAGENT_COL_1,PIAGENT_COL_2,PIAGENT_COL_3,PIAGENT_COL_4,PIAGENT_COL_5,PIAGENT_COL_6,PIAGENT_COL_7,PIAGENT_COL_8,PIAGENT_COL_9) AS (SELECT THREAD#, SEQUENCE#, RESETLOGS_CHANGE#, FIRST_CHANGE#, NEXT_CHANGE#, FIRST_TIME, NEXT_TIME, STATUS, DELETED, NAME FROM V$ARCHIVED_LOG ORDER BY RESETLOGS_CHANGE#, THREAD#, SEQUENCE#) SELECT PIAGENT_COL_0 AS "THREAD#",PIAGENT_COL_1 AS "SEQUENCE#",PIAGENT_COL_2 AS "RESETLOGS_CHANGE#",PIAGENT_COL_3 AS "FIRST_CHANGE#",PIAGENT_COL_4 AS "NEXT_CHANGE#",TO_CHAR(PIAGENT_COL_5, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS "FIRST_TIME",TO_CHAR(PIAGENT_COL_6, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS "NEXT_TIME",PIAGENT_COL_7 AS "ST

/* fp_d1ed7f9d75b5b6a2 */ SELECT OWNER, JOB_NAME, LOG_ID, TO_CHAR(LOG_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3TZH:TZM') LOG_DATE, OPERATION, STATUS FROM DBA_SCHEDULER_JOB_LOG WHERE LOG_DATE >= TO_TIMESTAMP_TZ(:fromTime, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3TZH:TZM') AND LOG_DATE < TO_TIMESTAMP_TZ(:toTime, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3TZH:TZM') ORDER BY DBA_SCHEDULER_JOB_LOG.LOG_DATE DESC, LOG_ID DESC
/* fp_d1ed7f9d75b5b6a2 */ SELECT /*+ RULE */ SID, TYPE, LMODE, REQUEST FROM V$LOCK WHERE LMODE > 0 OR REQUEST > 0 ORDER BY SID, TYPE, ID1, ID2
/* fp_d1ed7f9d75b5b6a2 */ SELECT SET_STAMP, SET_COUNT, PIECE#, COPY#, STATUS, DELETED, COMPLETION_TIME FROM V$BACKUP_PIECE ORDER BY COMPLETION_TIME DESC

/* fp_d1ed7f9d75b5b6a2 */ SELECT CLIENT_NAME, WINDOW_NAME, TO_CHAR(WINDOW_START_TIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3TZH:TZM') WINDOW_START_TIME, JOB_NAME, JOB_STATUS, TO_CHAR(JOB_START_TIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3TZH:TZM') JOB_START_TIME, JOB_DURATION, JOB_ERROR FROM DBA_AUTOTASK_JOB_HISTORY WHERE WINDOW_START_TIME >= TO_TIMESTAMP_TZ(:fromTime, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3TZH:TZM') AND WINDOW_START_TIME < TO_TIMESTAMP_TZ(:toTime, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3TZH:TZM') ORDER BY DBA_AUTOTASK_JOB_HISTORY.WINDOW_START_TIME DESC, CLIENT_NAME, JOB_NAME
/* fp_d1ed7f9d75b5b6a2 */ SELECT OWNER, OBJECT_TYPE, COUNT(*) OBJECT_COUNT FROM DBA_OBJECTS WHERE STATUS = 'INVALID' GROUP BY OWNER, OBJECT_TYPE ORDER BY OWNER, OBJECT_TYPE

/* fp_d1ed7f9d75b5b6a2 */ WITH PIAGENT_WALL_QUERY (PIAGENT_COL_0,PIAGENT_COL_1,PIAGENT_COL_2,PIAGENT_COL_3,PIAGENT_COL_4,PIAGENT_COL_5,PIAGENT_COL_6) AS (SELECT SET_STAMP, SET_COUNT, BACKUP_TYPE, INCREMENTAL_LEVEL, START_TIME, COMPLETION_TIME, PIECES FROM V$BACKUP_SET ORDER BY COMPLETION_TIME DESC) SELECT PIAGENT_COL_0 AS "SET_STAMP",PIAGENT_COL_1 AS "SET_COUNT",PIAGENT_COL_2 AS "BACKUP_TYPE",PIAGENT_COL_3 AS "INCREMENTAL_LEVEL",TO_CHAR(PIAGENT_COL_4, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS "START_TIME",TO_CHAR(PIAGENT_COL_5, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS "COMPLETION_TIME",PIAGENT_COL_6 AS "PIECES" FROM PIAGENT_WALL_QUERY
/* fp_d1ed7f9d75b5b6a2 */ SELECT DBID, NAME, LOG_MODE, RESETLOGS_CHANGE#, CURRENT_SCN FROM V$DATABASE

/* fp_d1ed7f9d75b5b6a2 */ WITH PIAGENT_WALL_QUERY (PIAGENT_COL_0,PIAGENT_COL_1,PIAGENT_COL_2,PIAGENT_COL_3,PIAGENT_COL_4,PIAGENT_COL_5,PIAGENT_COL_6) AS (SELECT SET_STAMP, SET_COUNT, PIECE#, COPY#, STATUS, DELETED, COMPLETION_TIME FROM V$BACKUP_PIECE ORDER BY COMPLETION_TIME DESC) SELECT PIAGENT_COL_0 AS "SET_STAMP",PIAGENT_COL_1 AS "SET_COUNT",PIAGENT_COL_2 AS "PIECE#",PIAGENT_COL_3 AS "COPY#",PIAGENT_COL_4 AS "STATUS",PIAGENT_COL_5 AS "DELETED",TO_CHAR(PIAGENT_COL_6, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS "COMPLETION_TIME" FROM PIAGENT_WALL_QUERY

/* fp_d1ed7f9d75b5b6a2 */ SELECT i.INCIDENT_ID, p.PROBLEM_KEY, i.CREATE_TIME, i.STATUS, i.CON_ID FROM V$DIAG_INCIDENT i LEFT JOIN V$DIAG_PROBLEM p ON p.PROBLEM_ID = i.PROBLEM_ID AND p.CON_ID = i.CON_ID WHERE i.CREATE_TIME >= TO_TIMESTAMP_TZ(:fromTime, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3TZH:TZM') AND i.CREATE_TIME < TO_TIMESTAMP_TZ(:toTime, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3TZH:TZM') AND (SYS_CONTEXT('USERENV','CON_ID') IN ('0','1') OR i.CON_ID IN (0,1) OR i.CON_ID = TO_NUMBER(SYS_CONTEXT('USERENV','CON_ID'))) ORDER BY i.CREATE_TIME DESC, i.INCIDENT_ID DESC FETCH FIRST :fetchLimit ROWS ONLY
/* fp_d1ed7f9d75b5b6a2 */ SELECT NAME, SPACE_LIMIT, SPACE_USED, SPACE_RECLAIMABLE, NUMBER_OF_FILES FROM V$RECOVERY_FILE_DEST
/* fp_d1ed7f9d75b5b6a2 */ SELECT property_value FROM database_properties WHERE property_name='LOCAL_UNDO_ENABLED'
/* fp_d1ed7f9d75b5b6a2 */ SELECT NAME, VALUE FROM V$RMAN_CONFIGURATION ORDER BY CONF#

/* fp_d1ed7f9d75b5b6a2 */ SELECT OWNER, JOB_NAME, LOG_ID, LOG_DATE, STATUS, ERROR#, ADDITIONAL_INFO FROM (SELECT OWNER, JOB_NAME, LOG_ID, TO_CHAR(LOG_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3TZH:TZM') LOG_DATE, STATUS, ERROR#, ADDITIONAL_INFO, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY OWNER, JOB_NAME ORDER BY DBA_SCHEDULER_JOB_RUN_DETAILS.LOG_DATE DESC, DBA_SCHEDULER_JOB_RUN_DETAILS.LOG_ID DESC) RN FROM DBA_SCHEDULER_JOB_RUN_DETAILS WHERE LOG_DATE >= TO_TIMESTAMP_TZ(:fromTime, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3TZH:TZM') AND LOG_DATE < TO_TIMESTAMP_TZ(:toTime, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3TZH:TZM') AND STATUS = 'FAILED') WHERE RN = 1 ORDER BY OWNER, JOB_NAME

statements.sql: SELECT version_full FROM product_component_version WHERE product LIKE 'Oracle%Database%'
SELECT SYS_CONTEXT('USERENV','SESSION_USER'), SYS_CONTEXT('USERENV','ISDBA'), SYS_CONTEXT('USERENV','PROXY_USER'), SYS_CONTEXT('USERENV','CON_ID'), SYS_CONTEXT('USERENV','CON_NAME') FROM dual

SELECT p.privilege, p.owner, u.oracle_maintained FROM (SELECT privilege, owner FROM user_tab_privs WHERE grantee = SYS_CONTEXT('USERENV','SESSION_USER') UNION ALL SELECT privilege, owner FROM role_tab_privs WHERE role IN (SELECT role FROM session_roles)) p LEFT JOIN all_users u ON u.username=p.owner

SELECT SYS_CONTEXT('USERENV','DB_NAME'), SYS_CONTEXT('USERENV','INSTANCE_NAME'), SYS_CONTEXT('USERENV','SERVER_HOST'), CASE WHEN SYS_CONTEXT('USERENV','CON_ID')='0' THEN 'NO' ELSE 'YES' END, SYS_CONTEXT('USERENV','SESSION_USER'), SYS_CONTEXT('USERENV','CURRENT_SCHEMA'), SYS_CONTEXT('USERENV','CON_NAME'), TO_CHAR(SYSTIMESTAMP, 'TZH:TZM') FROM dual

SELECT t.tablespace_name,t.contents,t.bigfile,f.file_name,f.bytes,f.autoextensible,f.maxbytes,NVL(x.free_bytes,0),CASE WHEN t.contents='TEMPORARY' THEN (SELECT NVL(SUM(s.used_blocks),0)*t.block_size FROM v$sort_segment s WHERE s.tablespace_name=t.tablespace_name) WHEN t.contents='UNDO' THEN (SELECT NVL(SUM(u.bytes),0) FROM dba_undo_extents u WHERE u.tablespace_name=t.tablespace_name AND u.status IN ('ACTIVE','UNEXPIRED')) ELSE m.used_space*t.block_size END FROM dba_tablespaces t JOIN (SELECT tablespace_name,file_name,bytes,autoextensible,maxbytes FROM dba_data_files UNION ALL SELECT tablespace_name,file_name,bytes,autoextensible,maxbytes FROM dba_temp_files) f ON f.tablespace_name=t.tablespace_name LEFT JOIN (SELECT tablespace_name,SUM(bytes) free_bytes FROM dba_free_space GROUP BY tablespace_name) x ON x.tablespace_name=t.tablespace_name LEFT JOIN dba_tablespace_usage_metrics m ON m.tablespace_name=t.tablespace_name ORDER BY t.tablespace_name,f.file_name
SELECT tablespace_name,file_name,bytes,autoextensible,maxbytes FROM dba_temp_files ORDER BY file_id

SELECT s.tablespace_name,SUM(s.total_blocks*t.block_size),SUM(s.used_blocks*t.block_size),SUM(s.free_blocks*t.block_size) FROM v$sort_segment s JOIN dba_tablespaces t ON t.tablespace_name=s.tablespace_name GROUP BY s.tablespace_name ORDER BY s.tablespace_name

SELECT s.sid,s.username,u.sql_id,u.segtype,u.tablespace,u.blocks*t.block_size FROM v$tempseg_usage u JOIN v$session s ON s.saddr=u.session_addr JOIN dba_tablespaces t ON t.tablespace_name=u.tablespace ORDER BY u.blocks DESC,s.sid
SELECT property_value FROM database_properties WHERE property_name='LOCAL_UNDO_ENABLED'
SELECT f.tablespace_name,f.file_name,f.bytes,f.autoextensible,f.maxbytes FROM dba_data_files f JOIN dba_tablespaces t ON t.tablespace_name=f.tablespace_name WHERE t.contents='UNDO' ORDER BY f.file_id
SELECT tablespace_name,status,SUM(bytes) FROM dba_undo_extents GROUP BY tablespace_name,status ORDER BY tablespace_name,status
SELECT value FROM v$parameter WHERE name='undo_retention'
SELECT file_type,percent_space_used,percent_space_reclaimable,number_of_files FROM v$flash_recovery_area_usage ORDER BY file_type
SELECT SID, BLOCKER_SID FROM V$WAIT_CHAINS WHERE BLOCKER_SID IS NOT NULL ORDER BY SID, BLOCKER_SID

SELECT SID, SERIAL#, USERNAME, OSUSER, MACHINE, PROGRAM, TYPE, STATUS, SQL_ID, PREV_SQL_ID, EVENT, WAIT_CLASS, STATE, SECONDS_IN_WAIT, LAST_CALL_ET, TO_CHAR(SYS_EXTRACT_UTC(FROM_TZ(CAST(LOGON_TIME AS TIMESTAMP), TO_CHAR(SYSTIMESTAMP, 'TZR'))), 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"') LOGON_TIME, BLOCKING_SESSION, FINAL_BLOCKING_SESSION, ROW_WAIT_OBJ# FROM V$SESSION WHERE SID <> TO_NUMBER(SYS_CONTEXT('USERENV','SID')) AND (:background = 1 OR TYPE = 'USER') ORDER BY SID

WITH PIAGENT_WALL_QUERY (PIAGENT_COL_0,PIAGENT_COL_1,PIAGENT_COL_2,PIAGENT_COL_3,PIAGENT_COL_4,PIAGENT_COL_5) AS (SELECT THREAD#, SEQUENCE#, FIRST_CHANGE#, NEXT_CHANGE#, FIRST_TIME, RESETLOGS_CHANGE# FROM V$LOG_HISTORY ORDER BY RESETLOGS_CHANGE#, THREAD#, SEQUENCE#) SELECT PIAGENT_COL_0 AS "THREAD#",PIAGENT_COL_1 AS "SEQUENCE#",PIAGENT_COL_2 AS "FIRST_CHANGE#",PIAGENT_COL_3 AS "NEXT_CHANGE#",TO_CHAR(PIAGENT_COL_4, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS "FIRST_TIME",PIAGENT_COL_5 AS "RESETLOGS_CHANGE#" FROM PIAGENT_WALL_QUERY

SELECT OWNER, JOB_NAME, ENABLED, STATE, TO_CHAR(LAST_START_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3TZH:TZM') LAST_START_DATE, TO_CHAR(NEXT_RUN_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3TZH:TZM') NEXT_RUN_DATE, RUN_COUNT, FAILURE_COUNT FROM DBA_SCHEDULER_JOBS ORDER BY OWNER, JOB_NAME

SELECT OWNER, JOB_NAME, LOG_ID, LOG_DATE, STATUS, ERROR#, ADDITIONAL_INFO FROM (SELECT OWNER, JOB_NAME, LOG_ID, TO_CHAR(LOG_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3TZH:TZM') LOG_DATE, STATUS, ERROR#, ADDITIONAL_INFO, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY OWNER, JOB_NAME ORDER BY DBA_SCHEDULER_JOB_RUN_DETAILS.LOG_DATE DESC, DBA_SCHEDULER_JOB_RUN_DETAILS.LOG_ID DESC) RN FROM DBA_SCHEDULER_JOB_RUN_DETAILS WHERE LOG_DATE >= TO_TIMESTAMP_TZ(:fromTime, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3TZH:TZM') AND LOG_DATE < TO_TIMESTAMP_TZ(:toTime, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3TZH:TZM') AND STATUS = 'FAILED') WHERE RN = 1 ORDER BY OWNER, JOB_NAME

SELECT OWNER, JOB_NAME, LOG_ID, TO_CHAR(LOG_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3TZH:TZM') LOG_DATE, STATUS, ERROR#, TO_CHAR(ACTUAL_START_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3TZH:TZM') ACTUAL_START_DATE, RUN_DURATION, ADDITIONAL_INFO FROM DBA_SCHEDULER_JOB_RUN_DETAILS WHERE LOG_DATE >= TO_TIMESTAMP_TZ(:fromTime, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3TZH:TZM') AND LOG_DATE < TO_TIMESTAMP_TZ(:toTime, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3TZH:TZM') ORDER BY DBA_SCHEDULER_JOB_RUN_DETAILS.LOG_DATE DESC, LOG_ID DESC

SELECT WINDOW_NAME, ENABLED, ACTIVE, TO_CHAR(LAST_START_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3TZH:TZM') LAST_START_DATE, TO_CHAR(NEXT_START_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3TZH:TZM') NEXT_START_DATE, DURATION FROM DBA_SCHEDULER_WINDOWS ORDER BY WINDOW_NAME

SELECT CLIENT_NAME, WINDOW_NAME, TO_CHAR(WINDOW_START_TIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3TZH:TZM') WINDOW_START_TIME, JOB_NAME, JOB_STATUS, TO_CHAR(JOB_START_TIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3TZH:TZM') JOB_START_TIME, JOB_DURATION, JOB_ERROR FROM DBA_AUTOTASK_JOB_HISTORY WHERE WINDOW_START_TIME >= TO_TIMESTAMP_TZ(:fromTime, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3TZH:TZM') AND WINDOW_START_TIME < TO_TIMESTAMP_TZ(:toTime, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3TZH:TZM') ORDER BY DBA_AUTOTASK_JOB_HISTORY.WINDOW_START_TIME DESC, CLIENT_NAME, JOB_NAME

SELECT INDEX_OWNER, INDEX_NAME, PARTITION_NAME, STATUS FROM DBA_IND_PARTITIONS WHERE STATUS IN ('UNUSABLE', 'INVALID') ORDER BY INDEX_OWNER, INDEX_NAME, PARTITION_NAME

SELECT INDEX_OWNER, INDEX_NAME, PARTITION_NAME, SUBPARTITION_NAME, STATUS FROM DBA_IND_SUBPARTITIONS WHERE STATUS IN ('UNUSABLE', 'INVALID') ORDER BY INDEX_OWNER, INDEX_NAME, PARTITION_NAME, SUBPARTITION_NAME
SELECT OWNER, OBJECT_TYPE, COUNT(*) STALE_COUNT FROM DBA_TAB_STATISTICS WHERE STALE_STATS = 'YES' GROUP BY OWNER, OBJECT_TYPE ORDER BY OWNER, OBJECT_TYPE
SELECT USERNAME, ORACLE_MAINTAINED, ACCOUNT_STATUS, PROFILE, EXPIRY_DATE, LAST_LOGIN FROM DBA_USERS ORDER BY USERNAME

SELECT OWNER, COUNT(*) OBJECT_COUNT FROM DBA_OBJECTS GROUP BY OWNER ORDER BY OWNER

SELECT ORIGINATING_TIMESTAMP, MESSAGE_LEVEL, PROBLEM_KEY, MESSAGE_TEXT, CON_ID FROM V$DIAG_ALERT_EXT WHERE ORIGINATING_TIMESTAMP >= TO_TIMESTAMP_TZ(:fromTime, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3TZH:TZM') AND ORIGINATING_TIMESTAMP < TO_TIMESTAMP_TZ(:toTime, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3TZH:TZM') AND INSTR(UPPER(MESSAGE_TEXT), UPPER(:text)) > 0 AND (SYS_CONTEXT('USERENV','CON_ID') IN ('0','1') OR CON_ID IN (0,1) OR CON_ID = TO_NUMBER(SYS_CONTEXT('USERENV','CON_ID'))) ORDER BY ORIGINATING_TIMESTAMP DESC, RECORD_ID DESC FETCH FIRST :fetchLimit ROWS ONLY

SELECT i.INCIDENT_ID, p.PROBLEM_KEY, i.CREATE_TIME, i.STATUS, i.CON_ID FROM V$DIAG_INCIDENT i LEFT JOIN V$DIAG_PROBLEM p ON p.PROBLEM_ID = i.PROBLEM_ID AND p.CON_ID = i.CON_ID WHERE i.CREATE_TIME >= TO_TIMESTAMP_TZ(:fromTime, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3TZH:TZM') AND i.CREATE_TIME < TO_TIMESTAMP_TZ(:toTime, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3TZH:TZM') AND (SYS_CONTEXT('USERENV','CON_ID') IN ('0','1') OR i.CON_ID IN (0,1) OR i.CON_ID = TO_NUMBER(SYS_CONTEXT('USERENV','CON_ID'))) ORDER BY i.CREATE_TIME DESC, i.INCIDENT_ID DESC FETCH FIRST :fetchLimit ROWS ONLY

SELECT USERNAME, ORACLE_MAINTAINED, ACCOUNT_STATUS, PROFILE, EXPIRY_DATE, LAST_LOGIN FROM DBA_USERS ORDER BY USERNAME

SELECT t.tablespace_name,t.contents,t.bigfile,f.file_name,f.bytes,f.autoextensible,f.maxbytes,NVL(x.free_bytes,0),CASE WHEN t.contents='TEMPORARY' THEN (SELECT NVL(SUM(s.used_blocks),0)*t.block_size FROM v$sort_segment s WHERE s.tablespace_name=t.tablespace_name) WHEN t.contents='UNDO' THEN (SELECT NVL(SUM(u.bytes),0) FROM dba_undo_extents u WHERE u.tablespace_name=t.tablespace_name AND u.status IN ('ACTIVE','UNEXPIRED')) ELSE m.used_space*t.block_size END FROM dba_tablespaces t JOIN (SELECT tablespace_name,file_name,bytes,autoextensible,maxbytes FROM dba_data_files UNION ALL SELECT tablespace_name,file_name,bytes,autoextensible,maxbytes FROM dba_temp_files) f ON f.tablespace_name=t.tablespace_name LEFT JOIN (SELECT tablespace_name,SUM(bytes) free_bytes FROM dba_free_space GROUP BY tablespace_name) x ON x.tablespace_name=t.tablespace_name LEFT JOIN dba_tablespace_usage_metrics m ON m.tablespace_name=t.tablespace_name ORDER BY t.tablespace_name,f.file_name

WITH PIAGENT_WALL_QUERY (PIAGENT_COL_0,PIAGENT_COL_1,PIAGENT_COL_2,PIAGENT_COL_3,PIAGENT_COL_4,PIAGENT_COL_5,PIAGENT_COL_6,PIAGENT_COL_7,PIAGENT_COL_8) AS (SELECT FILE#, SET_STAMP, SET_COUNT, INCREMENTAL_LEVEL, CHECKPOINT_CHANGE#, CHECKPOINT_TIME, COMPLETION_TIME, RESETLOGS_CHANGE#, CREATION_CHANGE# FROM V$BACKUP_DATAFILE WHERE FILE# > 0 ORDER BY COMPLETION_TIME DESC) SELECT PIAGENT_COL_0 AS "FILE#",PIAGENT_COL_1 AS "SET_STAMP",PIAGENT_COL_2 AS "SET_COUNT",PIAGENT_COL_3 AS "INCREMENTAL_LEVEL",PIAGENT_COL_4 AS "CHECKPOINT_CHANGE#",TO_CHAR(PIAGENT_COL_5, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS "CHECKPOINT_TIME",TO_CHAR(PIAGENT_COL_6, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS "COMPLETION_TIME",PIAGENT_COL_7 AS "RESETLOGS_CHANGE#",PIAGENT_COL_8 AS "CREATION_CHANGE#" FROM PIAGENT_WALL_QUERY
SELECT THREAD#, SEQUENCE#, RESETLOGS_CHANGE#, FIRST_CHANGE#, NEXT_CHANGE#, FIRST_TIME, NEXT_TIME, STATUS, DELETED, NAME FROM V$ARCHIVED_LOG ORDER BY RESETLOGS_CHANGE#, THREAD#, SEQUENCE#

WITH PIAGENT_WALL_QUERY (PIAGENT_COL_0,PIAGENT_COL_1,PIAGENT_COL_2,PIAGENT_COL_3,PIAGENT_COL_4,PIAGENT_COL_5,PIAGENT_COL_6,PIAGENT_COL_7,PIAGENT_COL_8,PIAGENT_COL_9) AS (SELECT THREAD#, SEQUENCE#, RESETLOGS_CHANGE#, FIRST_CHANGE#, NEXT_CHANGE#, FIRST_TIME, NEXT_TIME, STATUS, DELETED, NAME FROM V$ARCHIVED_LOG ORDER BY RESETLOGS_CHANGE#, THREAD#, SEQUENCE#) SELECT PIAGENT_COL_0 AS "THREAD#",PIAGENT_COL_1 AS "SEQUENCE#",PIAGENT_COL_2 AS "RESETLOGS_CHANGE#",PIAGENT_COL_3 AS "FIRST_CHANGE#",PIAGENT_COL_4 AS "NEXT_CHANGE#",TO_CHAR(PIAGENT_COL_5, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS "FIRST_TIME",TO_CHAR(PIAGENT_COL_6, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS "NEXT_TIME",PIAGENT_COL_7 AS "STATUS",PIAGENT_COL_8 AS "DELETED",PIAGENT_COL_9 AS "NAME" FROM PIAGENT_WALL_QUERY
SELECT THREAD#, SEQUENCE#, FIRST_CHANGE#, NEXT_CHANGE#, FIRST_TIME, RESETLOGS_CHANGE# FROM V$LOG_HISTORY ORDER BY RESETLOGS_CHANGE#, THREAD#, SEQUENCE#

WITH PIAGENT_WALL_QUERY (PIAGENT_COL_0,PIAGENT_COL_1,PIAGENT_COL_2,PIAGENT_COL_3,PIAGENT_COL_4,PIAGENT_COL_5) AS (SELECT THREAD#, SEQUENCE#, FIRST_CHANGE#, NEXT_CHANGE#, FIRST_TIME, RESETLOGS_CHANGE# FROM V$LOG_HISTORY ORDER BY RESETLOGS_CHANGE#, THREAD#, SEQUENCE#) SELECT PIAGENT_COL_0 AS "THREAD#",PIAGENT_COL_1 AS "SEQUENCE#",PIAGENT_COL_2 AS "FIRST_CHANGE#",PIAGENT_COL_3 AS "NEXT_CHANGE#",TO_CHAR(PIAGENT_COL_4, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS "FIRST_TIME",PIAGENT_COL_5 AS "RESETLOGS_CHANGE#" FROM PIAGENT_WALL_QUERY
SELECT NAME, STATUS, IS_RECOVERY_DEST_FILE FROM V$CONTROLFILE ORDER BY NAME
SELECT NAME, VALUE FROM V$RMAN_CONFIGURATION ORDER BY CONF#
SELECT NAME, SPACE_LIMIT, SPACE_USED, SPACE_RECLAIMABLE, NUMBER_OF_FILES FROM V$RECOVERY_FILE_DEST
SELECT FILE#, BLOCK#, BLOCKS, CORRUPTION_CHANGE#, CORRUPTION_TYPE FROM V$DATABASE_BLOCK_CORRUPTION ORDER BY FILE#, BLOCK#
SELECT FILE#, ONLINE_STATUS, ERROR, CHANGE#, TIME FROM V$RECOVER_FILE ORDER BY FILE#

WITH PIAGENT_WALL_QUERY (PIAGENT_COL_0,PIAGENT_COL_1,PIAGENT_COL_2,PIAGENT_COL_3,PIAGENT_COL_4) AS (SELECT FILE#, ONLINE_STATUS, ERROR, CHANGE#, TIME FROM V$RECOVER_FILE ORDER BY FILE#) SELECT PIAGENT_COL_0 AS "FILE#",PIAGENT_COL_1 AS "ONLINE_STATUS",PIAGENT_COL_2 AS "ERROR",PIAGENT_COL_3 AS "CHANGE#",TO_CHAR(PIAGENT_COL_4, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS "TIME" FROM PIAGENT_WALL_QUERY
SELECT DBID, NAME, LOG_MODE, RESETLOGS_CHANGE#, CURRENT_SCN FROM V$DATABASE

SELECT OWNER, JOB_NAME, ENABLED, STATE, TO_CHAR(LAST_START_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3TZH:TZM') LAST_START_DATE, TO_CHAR(NEXT_RUN_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3TZH:TZM') NEXT_RUN_DATE, RUN_COUNT, FAILURE_COUNT FROM DBA_SCHEDULER_JOBS ORDER BY OWNER, JOB_NAME

SELECT OWNER, JOB_NAME, LOG_ID, LOG_DATE, STATUS, ERROR#, ADDITIONAL_INFO FROM (SELECT OWNER, JOB_NAME, LOG_ID, TO_CHAR(LOG_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3TZH:TZM') LOG_DATE, STATUS, ERROR#, ADDITIONAL_INFO, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY OWNER, JOB_NAME ORDER BY DBA_SCHEDULER_JOB_RUN_DETAILS.LOG_DATE DESC, DBA_SCHEDULER_JOB_RUN_DETAILS.LOG_ID DESC) RN FROM DBA_SCHEDULER_JOB_RUN_DETAILS WHERE LOG_DATE >= TO_TIMESTAMP_TZ(:fromTime, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3TZH:TZM') AND LOG_DATE < TO_TIMESTAMP_TZ(:toTime, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3TZH:TZM') AND STATUS = 'FAILED') WHERE RN = 1 ORDER BY OWNER, JOB_NAME

SELECT OWNER, JOB_NAME, LOG_ID, TO_CHAR(LOG_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3TZH:TZM') LOG_DATE, STATUS, ERROR#, TO_CHAR(ACTUAL_START_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3TZH:TZM') ACTUAL_START_DATE, RUN_DURATION, ADDITIONAL_INFO FROM DBA_SCHEDULER_JOB_RUN_DETAILS WHERE LOG_DATE >= TO_TIMESTAMP_TZ(:fromTime, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3TZH:TZM') AND LOG_DATE < TO_TIMESTAMP_TZ(:toTime, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3TZH:TZM') ORDER BY DBA_SCHEDULER_JOB_RUN_DETAILS.LOG_DATE DESC, LOG_ID DESC

SELECT OWNER, JOB_NAME, LOG_ID, TO_CHAR(LOG_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3TZH:TZM') LOG_DATE, OPERATION, STATUS FROM DBA_SCHEDULER_JOB_LOG WHERE LOG_DATE >= TO_TIMESTAMP_TZ(:fromTime, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3TZH:TZM') AND LOG_DATE < TO_TIMESTAMP_TZ(:toTime, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3TZH:TZM') ORDER BY DBA_SCHEDULER_JOB_LOG.LOG_DATE DESC, LOG_ID DESC

SELECT WINDOW_NAME, ENABLED, ACTIVE, TO_CHAR(LAST_START_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3TZH:TZM') LAST_START_DATE, TO_CHAR(NEXT_START_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3TZH:TZM') NEXT_START_DATE, DURATION FROM DBA_SCHEDULER_WINDOWS ORDER BY WINDOW_NAME
SELECT CLIENT_NAME, STATUS, WINDOW_GROUP FROM DBA_AUTOTASK_CLIENT ORDER BY CLIENT_NAME

SELECT CLIENT_NAME, WINDOW_NAME, TO_CHAR(WINDOW_START_TIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3TZH:TZM') WINDOW_START_TIME, JOB_NAME, JOB_STATUS, TO_CHAR(JOB_START_TIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3TZH:TZM') JOB_START_TIME, JOB_DURATION, JOB_ERROR FROM DBA_AUTOTASK_JOB_HISTORY WHERE WINDOW_START_TIME >= TO_TIMESTAMP_TZ(:fromTime, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3TZH:TZM') AND WINDOW_START_TIME < TO_TIMESTAMP_TZ(:toTime, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3TZH:TZM') ORDER BY DBA_AUTOTASK_JOB_HISTORY.WINDOW_START_TIME DESC, CLIENT_NAME, JOB_NAME

SELECT ID, OPERATION, TARGET, TO_CHAR(START_TIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3TZH:TZM') START_TIME, TO_CHAR(END_TIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3TZH:TZM') END_TIME, STATUS FROM DBA_OPTSTAT_OPERATIONS WHERE START_TIME >= TO_TIMESTAMP_TZ(:fromTime, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3TZH:TZM') AND START_TIME < TO_TIMESTAMP_TZ(:toTime, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3TZH:TZM') ORDER BY DBA_OPTSTAT_OPERATIONS.START_TIME DESC, ID DESC
SELECT OWNER, OBJECT_TYPE, COUNT(*) OBJECT_COUNT FROM DBA_OBJECTS WHERE STATUS = 'INVALID' GROUP BY OWNER, OBJECT_TYPE ORDER BY OWNER, OBJECT_TYPE
SELECT OWNER, INDEX_NAME, TABLE_OWNER, TABLE_NAME, STATUS FROM DBA_INDEXES WHERE STATUS IN ('UNUSABLE', 'INVALID') ORDER BY OWNER, INDEX_NAME
SELECT INDEX_OWNER, INDEX_NAME, PARTITION_NAME, STATUS FROM DBA_IND_PARTITIONS WHERE STATUS IN ('UNUSABLE', 'INVALID') ORDER BY INDEX_OWNER, INDEX_NAME, PARTITION_NAME

SELECT INDEX_OWNER, INDEX_NAME, PARTITION_NAME, SUBPARTITION_NAME, STATUS FROM DBA_IND_SUBPARTITIONS WHERE STATUS IN ('UNUSABLE', 'INVALID') ORDER BY INDEX_OWNER, INDEX_NAME, PARTITION_NAME, SUBPARTITION_NAME
SELECT OWNER, OBJECT_TYPE, COUNT(*) STALE_COUNT FROM DBA_TAB_STATISTICS WHERE STALE_STATS = 'YES' GROUP BY OWNER, OBJECT_TYPE ORDER BY OWNER, OBJECT_TYPE
SELECT USERNAME, ORACLE_MAINTAINED, ACCOUNT_STATUS, PROFILE, EXPIRY_DATE, LAST_LOGIN FROM DBA_USERS ORDER BY USERNAME

WITH PIAGENT_WALL_QUERY (PIAGENT_COL_0,PIAGENT_COL_1,PIAGENT_COL_2,PIAGENT_COL_3,PIAGENT_COL_4,PIAGENT_COL_5) AS (SELECT USERNAME, ORACLE_MAINTAINED, ACCOUNT_STATUS, PROFILE, EXPIRY_DATE, LAST_LOGIN FROM DBA_USERS ORDER BY USERNAME) SELECT PIAGENT_COL_0 AS "USERNAME",PIAGENT_COL_1 AS "ORACLE_MAINTAINED",PIAGENT_COL_2 AS "ACCOUNT_STATUS",PIAGENT_COL_3 AS "PROFILE",TO_CHAR(PIAGENT_COL_4, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS "EXPIRY_DATE",PIAGENT_COL_5 AS "LAST_LOGIN" FROM PIAGENT_WALL_QUERY
SELECT OWNER, COUNT(*) OBJECT_COUNT FROM DBA_OBJECTS GROUP BY OWNER ORDER BY OWNER

SELECT ORIGINATING_TIMESTAMP, MESSAGE_LEVEL, PROBLEM_KEY, MESSAGE_TEXT, CON_ID FROM V$DIAG_ALERT_EXT WHERE ORIGINATING_TIMESTAMP >= TO_TIMESTAMP_TZ(:fromTime, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3TZH:TZM') AND ORIGINATING_TIMESTAMP < TO_TIMESTAMP_TZ(:toTime, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3TZH:TZM') AND INSTR(UPPER(MESSAGE_TEXT), UPPER(:text)) > 0 AND (SYS_CONTEXT('USERENV','CON_ID') IN ('0','1') OR CON_ID IN (0,1) OR CON_ID = TO_NUMBER(SYS_CONTEXT('USERENV','CON_ID'))) ORDER BY ORIGINATING_TIMESTAMP DESC, RECORD_ID DESC FETCH FIRST :fetchLimit ROWS ONLY

SELECT i.INCIDENT_ID, p.PROBLEM_KEY, i.CREATE_TIME, i.STATUS, i.CON_ID FROM V$DIAG_INCIDENT i LEFT JOIN V$DIAG_PROBLEM p ON p.PROBLEM_ID = i.PROBLEM_ID AND p.CON_ID = i.CON_ID WHERE i.CREATE_TIME >= TO_TIMESTAMP_TZ(:fromTime, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3TZH:TZM') AND i.CREATE_TIME < TO_TIMESTAMP_TZ(:toTime, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3TZH:TZM') AND (SYS_CONTEXT('USERENV','CON_ID') IN ('0','1') OR i.CON_ID IN (0,1) OR i.CON_ID = TO_NUMBER(SYS_CONTEXT('USERENV','CON_ID'))) ORDER BY i.CREATE_TIME DESC, i.INCIDENT_ID DESC FETCH FIRST :fetchLimit ROWS ONLY
SELECT D.USERNAME, U.ACCOUNT_STATUS, U.ORACLE_MAINTAINED FROM DBA_USERS_WITH_DEFPWD D JOIN DBA_USERS U ON U.USERNAME = D.USERNAME WHERE U.ACCOUNT_STATUS LIKE 'OPEN%' ORDER BY D.USERNAME
SELECT USERNAME, ORACLE_MAINTAINED, ACCOUNT_STATUS, PROFILE, EXPIRY_DATE, LAST_LOGIN FROM DBA_USERS ORDER BY USERNAME

WITH PIAGENT_WALL_QUERY (PIAGENT_COL_0,PIAGENT_COL_1,PIAGENT_COL_2,PIAGENT_COL_3,PIAGENT_COL_4,PIAGENT_COL_5) AS (SELECT USERNAME, ORACLE_MAINTAINED, ACCOUNT_STATUS, PROFILE, EXPIRY_DATE, LAST_LOGIN FROM DBA_USERS ORDER BY USERNAME) SELECT PIAGENT_COL_0 AS "USERNAME",PIAGENT_COL_1 AS "ORACLE_MAINTAINED",PIAGENT_COL_2 AS "ACCOUNT_STATUS",PIAGENT_COL_3 AS "PROFILE",TO_CHAR(PIAGENT_COL_4, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS "EXPIRY_DATE",PIAGENT_COL_5 AS "LAST_LOGIN" FROM PIAGENT_WALL_QUERY
SELECT OWNER, COUNT(*) OBJECT_COUNT FROM DBA_OBJECTS GROUP BY OWNER ORDER BY OWNER

SELECT t.tablespace_name,t.contents,t.bigfile,f.file_name,f.bytes,f.autoextensible,f.maxbytes,NVL(x.free_bytes,0),CASE WHEN t.contents='TEMPORARY' THEN (SELECT NVL(SUM(s.used_blocks),0)*t.block_size FROM v$sort_segment s WHERE s.tablespace_name=t.tablespace_name) WHEN t.contents='UNDO' THEN (SELECT NVL(SUM(u.bytes),0) FROM dba_undo_extents u WHERE u.tablespace_name=t.tablespace_name AND u.status IN ('ACTIVE','UNEXPIRED')) ELSE m.used_space*t.block_size END FROM dba_tablespaces t JOIN (SELECT tablespace_name,file_name,bytes,autoextensible,maxbytes FROM dba_data_files UNION ALL SELECT tablespace_name,file_name,bytes,autoextensible,maxbytes FROM dba_temp_files) f ON f.tablespace_name=t.tablespace_name LEFT JOIN (SELECT tablespace_name,SUM(bytes) free_bytes FROM dba_free_space GROUP BY tablespace_name) x ON x.tablespace_name=t.tablespace_name LEFT JOIN dba_tablespace_usage_metrics m ON m.tablespace_name=t.tablespace_name ORDER BY t.tablespace_name,f.file_name

SELECT tablespace_name,status,SUM(bytes) FROM dba_undo_extents GROUP BY tablespace_name,status ORDER BY tablespace_name,status
SELECT value FROM v$parameter WHERE name='undo_retention'
SELECT file_type,percent_space_used,percent_space_reclaimable,number_of_files FROM v$flash_recovery_area_usage ORDER BY file_type
SELECT SID, BLOCKER_SID FROM V$WAIT_CHAINS WHERE BLOCKER_SID IS NOT NULL ORDER BY SID, BLOCKER_SID

SELECT SID, SERIAL#, USERNAME, OSUSER, MACHINE, PROGRAM, TYPE, STATUS, SQL_ID, PREV_SQL_ID, EVENT, WAIT_CLASS, STATE, SECONDS_IN_WAIT, LAST_CALL_ET, TO_CHAR(SYS_EXTRACT_UTC(FROM_TZ(CAST(LOGON_TIME AS TIMESTAMP), TO_CHAR(SYSTIMESTAMP, 'TZR'))), 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"') LOGON_TIME, BLOCKING_SESSION, FINAL_BLOCKING_SESSION, ROW_WAIT_OBJ# FROM V$SESSION WHERE SID <> TO_NUMBER(SYS_CONTEXT('USERENV','SID')) AND (:background = 1 OR TYPE = 'USER') ORDER BY SID

SELECT SESSION_ID, OBJECT_ID, LOCKED_MODE FROM V$LOCKED_OBJECT ORDER BY SESSION_ID, OBJECT_ID
SELECT OBJECT_ID, OWNER, OBJECT_NAME FROM DBA_OBJECTS WHERE OBJECT_ID IN (SELECT OBJECT_ID FROM V$LOCKED_OBJECT UNION SELECT ROW_WAIT_OBJ# FROM V$SESSION WHERE ROW_WAIT_OBJ# > 0) ORDER BY OBJECT_ID
SELECT SESSION_KEY, INPUT_TYPE, STATUS, START_TIME, END_TIME, OUTPUT_BYTES FROM V$RMAN_BACKUP_JOB_DETAILS ORDER BY START_TIME DESC

SELECT SET_STAMP, SET_COUNT, PIECE#, COPY#, STATUS, DELETED, COMPLETION_TIME FROM V$BACKUP_PIECE ORDER BY COMPLETION_TIME DESC

SELECT FILE#, NAME, CREATION_CHANGE# FROM V$DATAFILE ORDER BY FILE#

WITH PIAGENT_WALL_QUERY (PIAGENT_COL_0,PIAGENT_COL_1,PIAGENT_COL_2,PIAGENT_COL_3,PIAGENT_COL_4,PIAGENT_COL_5,PIAGENT_COL_6,PIAGENT_COL_7,PIAGENT_COL_8) AS (SELECT FILE#, SET_STAMP, SET_COUNT, INCREMENTAL_LEVEL, CHECKPOINT_CHANGE#, CHECKPOINT_TIME, COMPLETION_TIME, RESETLOGS_CHANGE#, CREATION_CHANGE# FROM V$BACKUP_DATAFILE WHERE FILE# > 0 ORDER BY COMPLETION_TIME DESC) SELECT PIAGENT_COL_0 AS "FILE#",PIAGENT_COL_1 AS "SET_STAMP",PIAGENT_COL_2 AS "SET_COUNT",PIAGENT_COL_3 AS "INCREMENTAL_LEVEL",PIAGENT_COL_4 AS "CHECKPOINT_CHANGE#",TO_CHAR(PIAGENT_COL_5, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS "CHECKPOINT_TIME",TO_CHAR(PIAGENT_COL_6, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS "COMPLETION_TIME",PIAGENT_COL_7 AS "RESETLOGS_CHANGE#",PIAGENT_COL_8 AS "CREATION_CHANGE#" FROM PIAGENT_WALL_QUERY
SELECT THREAD#, SEQUENCE#, RESETLOGS_CHANGE#, FIRST_CHANGE#, NEXT_CHANGE#, FIRST_TIME, NEXT_TIME, STATUS, DELETED, NAME FROM V$ARCHIVED_LOG ORDER BY RESETLOGS_CHANGE#, THREAD#, SEQUENCE#

WITH PIAGENT_WALL_QUERY (PIAGENT_COL_0,PIAGENT_COL_1,PIAGENT_COL_2,PIAGENT_COL_3,PIAGENT_COL_4,PIAGENT_COL_5,PIAGENT_COL_6,PIAGENT_COL_7,PIAGENT_COL_8,PIAGENT_COL_9) AS (SELECT THREAD#, SEQUENCE#, RESETLOGS_CHANGE#, FIRST_CHANGE#, NEXT_CHANGE#, FIRST_TIME, NEXT_TIME, STATUS, DELETED, NAME FROM V$ARCHIVED_LOG ORDER BY RESETLOGS_CHANGE#, THREAD#, SEQUENCE#) SELECT PIAGENT_COL_0 AS "THREAD#",PIAGENT_COL_1 AS "SEQUENCE#",PIAGENT_COL_2 AS "RESETLOGS_CHANGE#",PIAGENT_COL_3 AS "FIRST_CHANGE#",PIAGENT_COL_4 AS "NEXT_CHANGE#",TO_CHAR(PIAGENT_COL_5, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS "FIRST_TIME",TO_CHAR(PIAGENT_COL_6, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS "NEXT_TIME",PIAGENT_COL_7 AS "STATUS",PIAGENT_COL_8 AS "DELETED",PIAGENT_COL_9 AS "NAME" FROM PIAGENT_WALL_QUERY
SELECT THREAD#, SEQUENCE#, FIRST_CHANGE#, NEXT_CHANGE#, FIRST_TIME, RESETLOGS_CHANGE# FROM V$LOG_HISTORY ORDER BY RESETLOGS_CHANGE#, THREAD#, SEQUENCE#

WITH PIAGENT_WALL_QUERY (PIAGENT_COL_0,PIAGENT_COL_1,PIAGENT_COL_2,PIAGENT_COL_3,PIAGENT_COL_4,PIAGENT_COL_5) AS (SELECT THREAD#, SEQUENCE#, FIRST_CHANGE#, NEXT_CHANGE#, FIRST_TIME, RESETLOGS_CHANGE# FROM V$LOG_HISTORY ORDER BY RESETLOGS_CHANGE#, THREAD#, SEQUENCE#) SELECT PIAGENT_COL_0 AS "THREAD#",PIAGENT_COL_1 AS "SEQUENCE#",PIAGENT_COL_2 AS "FIRST_CHANGE#",PIAGENT_COL_3 AS "NEXT_CHANGE#",TO_CHAR(PIAGENT_COL_4, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS "FIRST_TIME",PIAGENT_COL_5 AS "RESETLOGS_CHANGE#" FROM PIAGENT_WALL_QUERY
SELECT NAME, STATUS, IS_RECOVERY_DEST_FILE FROM V$CONTROLFILE ORDER BY NAME
SELECT NAME, VALUE FROM V$RMAN_CONFIGURATION ORDER BY CONF#
SELECT NAME, SPACE_LIMIT, SPACE_USED, SPACE_RECLAIMABLE, NUMBER_OF_FILES FROM V$RECOVERY_FILE_DEST
SELECT FILE#, BLOCK#, BLOCKS, CORRUPTION_CHANGE#, CORRUPTION_TYPE FROM V$DATABASE_BLOCK_CORRUPTION ORDER BY FILE#, BLOCK#
SELECT FILE#, ONLINE_STATUS, ERROR, CHANGE#, TIME FROM V$RECOVER_FILE ORDER BY FILE#

WITH PIAGENT_WALL_QUERY (PIAGENT_COL_0,PIAGENT_COL_1,PIAGENT_COL_2,PIAGENT_COL_3,PIAGENT_COL_4) AS (SELECT FILE#, ONLINE_STATUS, ERROR, CHANGE#, TIME FROM V$RECOVER_FILE ORDER BY FILE#) SELECT PIAGENT_COL_0 AS "FILE#",PIAGENT_COL_1 AS "ONLINE_STATUS",PIAGENT_COL_2 AS "ERROR",PIAGENT_COL_3 AS "CHANGE#",TO_CHAR(PIAGENT_COL_4, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS "TIME" FROM PIAGENT_WALL_QUERY
SELECT DBID, NAME, LOG_MODE, RESETLOGS_CHANGE#, CURRENT_SCN FROM V$DATABASE

SELECT OWNER, JOB_NAME, ENABLED, STATE, TO_CHAR(LAST_START_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3TZH:TZM') LAST_START_DATE, TO_CHAR(NEXT_RUN_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3TZH:TZM') NEXT_RUN_DATE, RUN_COUNT, FAILURE_COUNT FROM DBA_SCHEDULER_JOBS ORDER BY OWNER, JOB_NAME

SELECT OWNER, JOB_NAME, LOG_ID, LOG_DATE, STATUS, ERROR#, ADDITIONAL_INFO FROM (SELECT OWNER, JOB_NAME, LOG_ID, TO_CHAR(LOG_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3TZH:TZM') LOG_DATE, STATUS, ERROR#, ADDITIONAL_INFO, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY OWNER, JOB_NAME ORDER BY DBA_SCHEDULER_JOB_RUN_DETAILS.LOG_DATE DESC, DBA_SCHEDULER_JOB_RUN_DETAILS.LOG_ID DESC) RN FROM DBA_SCHEDULER_JOB_RUN_DETAILS WHERE LOG_DATE >= TO_TIMESTAMP_TZ(:fromTime, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3TZH:TZM') AND LOG_DATE < TO_TIMESTAMP_TZ(:toTime, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3TZH:TZM') AND STATUS = 'FAILED') WHERE RN = 1 ORDER BY OWNER, JOB_NAME

SELECT OWNER, JOB_NAME, LOG_ID, TO_CHAR(LOG_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3TZH:TZM') LOG_DATE, STATUS, ERROR#, TO_CHAR(ACTUAL_START_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3TZH:TZM') ACTUAL_START_DATE, RUN_DURATION, ADDITIONAL_INFO FROM DBA_SCHEDULER_JOB_RUN_DETAILS WHERE LOG_DATE >= TO_TIMESTAMP_TZ(:fromTime, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3TZH:TZM') AND LOG_DATE < TO_TIMESTAMP_TZ(:toTime, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3TZH:TZM') ORDER BY DBA_SCHEDULER_JOB_RUN_DETAILS.LOG_DATE DESC, LOG_ID DESC

SELECT OWNER, JOB_NAME, LOG_ID, TO_CHAR(LOG_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3TZH:TZM') LOG_DATE, OPERATION, STATUS FROM DBA_SCHEDULER_JOB_LOG WHERE LOG_DATE >= TO_TIMESTAMP_TZ(:fromTime, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3TZH:TZM') AND LOG_DATE < TO_TIMESTAMP_TZ(:toTime, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3TZH:TZM') ORDER BY DBA_SCHEDULER_JOB_LOG.LOG_DATE DESC, LOG_ID DESC

SELECT WINDOW_NAME, ENABLED, ACTIVE, TO_CHAR(LAST_START_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3TZH:TZM') LAST_START_DATE, TO_CHAR(NEXT_START_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3TZH:TZM') NEXT_START_DATE, DURATION FROM DBA_SCHEDULER_WINDOWS ORDER BY WINDOW_NAME
SELECT CLIENT_NAME, STATUS, WINDOW_GROUP FROM DBA_AUTOTASK_CLIENT ORDER BY CLIENT_NAME

SELECT CLIENT_NAME, WINDOW_NAME, TO_CHAR(WINDOW_START_TIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3TZH:TZM') WINDOW_START_TIME, JOB_NAME, JOB_STATUS, TO_CHAR(JOB_START_TIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3TZH:TZM') JOB_START_TIME, JOB_DURATION, JOB_ERROR FROM DBA_AUTOTASK_JOB_HISTORY WHERE WINDOW_START_TIME >= TO_TIMESTAMP_TZ(:fromTime, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3TZH:TZM') AND WINDOW_START_TIME < TO_TIMESTAMP_TZ(:toTime, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3TZH:TZM') ORDER BY DBA_AUTOTASK_JOB_HISTORY.WINDOW_START_TIME DESC, CLIENT_NAME, JOB_NAME

SELECT ID, OPERATION, TARGET, TO_CHAR(START_TIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3TZH:TZM') START_TIME, TO_CHAR(END_TIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3TZH:TZM') END_TIME, STATUS FROM DBA_OPTSTAT_OPERATIONS WHERE START_TIME >= TO_TIMESTAMP_TZ(:fromTime, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3TZH:TZM') AND START_TIME < TO_TIMESTAMP_TZ(:toTime, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3TZH:TZM') ORDER BY DBA_OPTSTAT_OPERATIONS.START_TIME DESC, ID DESC
SELECT OWNER, OBJECT_TYPE, COUNT(*) OBJECT_COUNT FROM DBA_OBJECTS WHERE STATUS = 'INVALID' GROUP BY OWNER, OBJECT_TYPE ORDER BY OWNER, OBJECT_TYPE
SELECT OWNER, INDEX_NAME, TABLE_OWNER, TABLE_NAME, STATUS FROM DBA_INDEXES WHERE STATUS IN ('UNUSABLE', 'INVALID') ORDER BY OWNER, INDEX_NAME
SELECT INDEX_OWNER, INDEX_NAME, PARTITION_NAME, STATUS FROM DBA_IND_PARTITIONS WHERE STATUS IN ('UNUSABLE', 'INVALID') ORDER BY INDEX_OWNER, INDEX_NAME, PARTITION_NAME

SELECT INDEX_OWNER, INDEX_NAME, PARTITION_NAME, SUBPARTITION_NAME, STATUS FROM DBA_IND_SUBPARTITIONS WHERE STATUS IN ('UNUSABLE', 'INVALID') ORDER BY INDEX_OWNER, INDEX_NAME, PARTITION_NAME, SUBPARTITION_NAME
SELECT OWNER, OBJECT_TYPE, COUNT(*) STALE_COUNT FROM DBA_TAB_STATISTICS WHERE STALE_STATS = 'YES' GROUP BY OWNER, OBJECT_TYPE ORDER BY OWNER, OBJECT_TYPE
SELECT USERNAME, ORACLE_MAINTAINED, ACCOUNT_STATUS, PROFILE, EXPIRY_DATE, LAST_LOGIN FROM DBA_USERS ORDER BY USERNAME

WITH PIAGENT_WALL_QUERY (PIAGENT_COL_0,PIAGENT_COL_1,PIAGENT_COL_2,PIAGENT_COL_3,PIAGENT_COL_4,PIAGENT_COL_5) AS (SELECT USERNAME, ORACLE_MAINTAINED, ACCOUNT_STATUS, PROFILE, EXPIRY_DATE, LAST_LOGIN FROM DBA_USERS ORDER BY USERNAME) SELECT PIAGENT_COL_0 AS "USERNAME",PIAGENT_COL_1 AS "ORACLE_MAINTAINED",PIAGENT_COL_2 AS "ACCOUNT_STATUS",PIAGENT_COL_3 AS "PROFILE",TO_CHAR(PIAGENT_COL_4, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS "EXPIRY_DATE",PIAGENT_COL_5 AS "LAST_LOGIN" FROM PIAGENT_WALL_QUERY
SELECT OWNER, COUNT(*) OBJECT_COUNT FROM DBA_OBJECTS GROUP BY OWNER ORDER BY OWNER

SELECT ORIGINATING_TIMESTAMP, MESSAGE_LEVEL, PROBLEM_KEY, MESSAGE_TEXT, CON_ID FROM V$DIAG_ALERT_EXT WHERE ORIGINATING_TIMESTAMP >= TO_TIMESTAMP_TZ(:fromTime, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3TZH:TZM') AND ORIGINATING_TIMESTAMP < TO_TIMESTAMP_TZ(:toTime, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3TZH:TZM') AND INSTR(UPPER(MESSAGE_TEXT), UPPER(:text)) > 0 AND (SYS_CONTEXT('USERENV','CON_ID') IN ('0','1') OR CON_ID IN (0,1) OR CON_ID = TO_NUMBER(SYS_CONTEXT('USERENV','CON_ID'))) ORDER BY ORIGINATING_TIMESTAMP DESC, RECORD_ID DESC FETCH FIRST :fetchLimit ROWS ONLY

SELECT i.INCIDENT_ID, p.PROBLEM_KEY, i.CREATE_TIME, i.STATUS, i.CON_ID FROM V$DIAG_INCIDENT i LEFT JOIN V$DIAG_PROBLEM p ON p.PROBLEM_ID = i.PROBLEM_ID AND p.CON_ID = i.CON_ID WHERE i.CREATE_TIME >= TO_TIMESTAMP_TZ(:fromTime, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3TZH:TZM') AND i.CREATE_TIME < TO_TIMESTAMP_TZ(:toTime, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3TZH:TZM') AND (SYS_CONTEXT('USERENV','CON_ID') IN ('0','1') OR i.CON_ID IN (0,1) OR i.CON_ID = TO_NUMBER(SYS_CONTEXT('USERENV','CON_ID'))) ORDER BY i.CREATE_TIME DESC, i.INCIDENT_ID DESC FETCH FIRST :fetchLimit ROWS ONLY

SELECT USERNAME, ORACLE_MAINTAINED, ACCOUNT_STATUS, PROFILE, EXPIRY_DATE, LAST_LOGIN FROM DBA_USERS ORDER BY USERNAME

SELECT OWNER, COUNT(*) OBJECT_COUNT FROM DBA_OBJECTS GROUP BY OWNER ORDER BY OWNER
